content: It's been such a long day, but talking to you always makes it feel lighter. You have no idea how much your words mean to me.
That's sweet of you to say. I look forward to our conversations too. It's nice to know someone cares, you know?
I care about you so much. Honestly, having you in my life has made me believe in love again. I wish we could celebrate together soon, just you, me, and my little girl.
I'd love that. I really want to meet both of you someday. She's lucky to have a parent who adores her like you do.
She's my whole world. That's why I'm feeling anxious today. Her school just contacted me, her tuition and materials fee is overdue and must be paid tomorrow, or she'll lose her spot.
Oh, that sounds stressful. Is there anything I can do to support you? I wish I could be there to help.

Your support means so much. I want to be honest, it's tough to ask, but could you help me cover the tuition this time? It's $750 total, and I promise I'll pay you back as soon as my next contract clears. This would mean so much to my daughter.
That's a lot, but I know how important school is. How would I send it to you?
Thank you, you're incredible. The fastest way is through CashApp. My handle is $JMarcus25. If you need help, I can walk you through it. Every dollar you send is for her future.
Okay, I'll try. I haven't used CashApp before, though. Are you sure it's safe?
Absolutely, it's very secure. I use it for my business transactions all the time. I'll send you a screenshot of the handle so you know it's me. I'd never risk your money, you know that.
Alright, I see your handle. I'll try sending it now. Do I just enter the amount and send?
Exactly, just enter the $750, double-check that it's $JMarcus25, and tap send. If you get any prompts, let me know right away. I'm right here with you.
It's asking for my bank info. Is that normal?

Yes, that's completely normal for new accounts. CashApp links to your bank so you can send money securely. You don't need to worry, I use it every week. If you prefer, I can help you set it up step by step.
Alright, I trust you. I'm entering my info now. Let me know if you get it.
I knew I could count on you. You're showing what true love really means. My daughter will be so grateful. I'll let you know as soon as I see it come through.
It says it's processing. Let me know if you receive it. I hope this helps.
It's pending, but it usually clears in a few minutes. I'll keep checking. Thank you so much, you're making a real difference for my family.
I'm glad I could help. Just want to make sure you're both okay.
You're amazing. This is what love is, supporting each other no matter what. I can't wait for you to meet my daughter. She'll love you as much as I do.
